newsitem.title: UK: SBS Group plans AIM float and sees higher profile.
newsitem.headline: SBS Group plans AIM float and sees higher profile.

text.p: Specialist IT recruitment agency SBS Group Plc said on Wednesday it was planning to float on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) later this month.
The group said it hoped to raise approximately one million stg after expenses and expected to have a market capitalisation of six million stg on admission to AIM.
SBS said the proceeds from the float will be used to provide working capital, to give flexibility to finance future acquisitions and to reduce gearing.

The group markets its services to about 4,500 organisations, the majority having large IT departments. These include Banque Paribas, BZW, Citibank, London Clearing House, London Electricity, Norwich Union and Prudential Portfolio Managers.
SBS said in the year to August 31 1996, it had sales of 15.2 million stg and made a gross profit of 3.3 million stg with the pre-tax profit figure coming in at 400,000 stg.
The group said it believed the market for IT contractors will continue its recent expansion and that the float should raise the group's profile in the industry.
